title: Rooted bicubic planar maps via Dyck paths
summary: We provide a combinatorial proof of Tutte's decomposition of rooted bicubic planar maps into 3-connected components. Motivated by the framework of Bell transformations, we establish an explicit bijection between rooted bicubic planar maps on $2n$ vertices and Dyck paths of semilength $3n$ with ascents of length divisible by 3, where each $3j$-ascent is colored using one of $g_j$ colors corresponding to the rooted 3-connected bicubic maps on $2j$ vertices.
